coverage: COMPLETE DATASET: 63 compressional-wave velocity measurements on Leg 69 basalt cores, 279.08 -> 484.04 mbsf, Vp = 5,105-6,390 m/s, every row instrument-tagged '-/-/F'. source_anomaly_disclosure: The final depth 484.04 m carries TWO rows with the IDENTICAL sample label (69-504B-29-1,4) and two different velocities (5,105 and 5,136 m/s) - a repeat measurement on the same sample archived as two rows, preserved verbatim and pinned as the profile's only duplicate-depth point (0.6% repeatability spread).
purpose: twenty-fifth catalogue entry - 504B becomes a FOUR-dataset site family (1979 sound velocity + 1979 physical properties + 1986 dike elastic moduli + 1991 borehole fluids), kind SEVENTEEN, and the catalogue's first CROSS-ENTRY SAMPLE-BY-SAMPLE JOIN: the 1979 Vp rows pair with the 1979 density rows from the same cores (many at identical cm positions: 6-1,55; 7-5,3; 8-3,73; 13-2,100), letting the gate compute a live acoustic-impedance profile Z = rho x Vp of 1979 ocean-floor basalt from two independently archived datasets
verified: 63 rows / 189 counted cells against the header Size declaration; endpoints and Vp extremes; duplicate-depth repeat pair at 484.04 m; cross-entry join against dsdp_504b_physical_properties on depth (|dz| <= 0.05 m) with live Z = rho*Vp impedance computation; gate-pinned; source URL serves the identical dataset
